notes.title: Next Updates - request for wishlist
notes.content:
Please chekc the discussion forum for the update 1.5x sugestions. I would  like to hear about any wishes you have, or priorisation on the todo list :

2. more infos on the ships (two page setting) in KARA
3. New LINERS and TANKERS section
4. New Accessory section (anti pirate shields to prevent ...)
5. Setting periodic routes (still some ideas needed, probable done in the office - select a ship then an offer for a periodic liner, and options of strategie like behavior on events)
6. Stock Market as in pocxxl
7. ACHIEVEMENTs - have already a list of around 30 achievments like, get a ship, solving the rescue scene etc,
--- LET ME KNOW on the priority, currently 1..7 is my todo priority, 7. will probably disable windows 7 using ... as the steam library is no longer compatible. 

8. I have some more on the list but want to wait until I reveal this.

Tell me abour your thoughts.

notes.title: Update 1.55
notes.content:
A nasty safe bug
was introduced with 1.5x -- the path shown in the header of SAFE and LOAD was no longer created, so without manual creation a safe error occured . Now this should create the missing path and some additional checks are done. Users which started on 1.4x do have the path already, so creating is skipped.

by the way, PLEASE REPORT BUGs and Problems into the DISCUSSION first before you write a negative review which is not helpful, also describe the problem and used PC, OS etc as good as possible - I will try to fix problems ASAP.

notes.title: Update 1.55 - SAFE BUG -- directory creation
notes.content:
[h2][h1]SAFE PROBLEMS[/h1][/h2]
A nasty[b] safe bug [/b]was introduced with 1.5x -- the path shown in the header of SAFE and LOAD was no longer created, so without manual creation a safe error occured . Now this should create the missing path and some additional checks are done. Users which started on 1.4x do have the path already, so creating is skipped.

by the way, PLEASE REPORT BUGs and Problems into the DISCUSSION first before you write a negative review which is not helpful, also describe the problem and used PC, OS etc as good as possible - I will try to fix problems ASAP.

notes.title: Update 1.54 SHip view in Captain's Wall + Bugfix Panama routing
notes.content:
Really agaian an update, this time one very nice user wish to add the small ship icon to the captain's wall, this will help identifing the ship. 
A important bug fix. Due to a name change (Colón to Colon) due to language setting problems, I forgot to change all, and therefore mostly the panama canal is not used instead the Cap Horn route. This should be fixed now. Start with a small ship in Los Angeles and Set Course to Caracas for example.

notes.title: Update 1.53 - Music in harbours and ETA bugfixes
notes.content:
1. Update 1.53
Bugfixed the ETA was missing the captains wall, now added again. Also changed it now shows the time to travel plus the load and unload time. So this should get better estimation. Attention in the rest of the menues you will only see the travel time.
2. User Wish Music in Harbours.
As in the classic POCXXL version now harbours can have music when arriving, I added all the POCXXL music parts plus some new music.
Here some examples for the ETA also some images for teh Japanese version. and dont wonder for testing especially the harbour musics  I use the very fast FUTURA ship. So ETA is small here, for this kind of ship there is no load and unload time.
3. currenty music is in a.wav format you can add them yourself but I will if intersted make a tutorial or workshop on this. also volunteered music or harbour images are welcome. You then get into the ABOUT list.

notes.title: Update 1.52
notes.content: Small update, for GERMAN and foreign users, as we had problems when the local numeric has "," set as numeric seperator, this new version overrides it. Important change otherwise berth positions and moving objects dont follow along the path - this might be a very old bug explaining some comments in the past !.

notes.title: Ports Of Call Deluxe 2024 Update 1.51
notes.content:
HINT for GERMANY USERS:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ACHTUNG, ein alter Bug gefunden, für Deutsches Setting : Bitte unter Einstellungen für Zahlendarstellung wenn alles auf Deutsch steht Gruppentrennung auf "." bitte auf "," KOMMA aendern und Dezimalstelle mit PUNK "." statt deuscthes KOMMA, dann gehen auch die Anlegestellen. 

ATTENTION we found an old bug, LANGUAGE Setting for NUMBERS please set group to "," and dezimal point to "." -- ESPECIALLY FOR GERMAN

will come an update as soon as I find a way to patch it.... its the SCANF function in C my PC use english most...
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Update 1.51,
the 1.50 was only short only, because some reported problems on the speed control display, some PCs did have a problem, I found a easy solution and fixed this hopefully...so far tested.
small change:
UFO now has its own speed control (was part of the bug)
Russian version had a problem with Manzilla Colon --- The o without graf now works.
------------------------------------------------------------
Update 1.50

Lots of enhancements, features and addons have been done since the release of 1.40. A lot of the user wishes in the discussion forum which was very helpful
are also implemented.

1. Font sizes have be changed also to be able to the game on 4k monitors.
2. New cursor now prevents it from disapearing on some machines.
3. Languages can be selected after start, also enabled user addon languages.
4. Stereo slider postions optimized.
5. WASD navigation added for ship control (Use STRG and SHIFT for the optional side rudders
6. Horn Added H Key to play the horn
7. SHIFT-B accellerates by 10 and STRG-B by 5 , as long the gamepad is not touched, enables fast navigation in large habours
8. Warnign on missing output pin message and how to solve (can be ignored only for video in the game on a texture)
9. New color hints for different office colors using the multiplayer and display on world map etc.
10. New OPTION Arcade, starting here with alternative harbours, for this time only some as New Yokr replacing them with simple ones
 more will come later if you liek this option
11. New backrgound AI generated
12. SPeed control in the WORLD menu, to accellerate the game progress.
13. new features in the WORLD menue click on a user then on the ship and you see the current status of the ship and the current route as lines
14. additional infos when a storm event comes up as condition of the ship
15. new Ship infos in the office, dtae of purchase and year of built etc.
16. additional infos when selecting BALAST for choosing a route as length etc.
17. New optin in the Weather menu ALT-W waveheight and many more. Attention if ocean height is to heigh harbours may be little bit flooded.
18. New ship forms in world Menu to distinguish the ship types
19. Submarine and UFO have new attributes, for example event protection and floating on shallow areas as the hovercraft also does.
20. NEW Autosave options now in the SAVE Menu, help preserving the game state.
21. KARA has a new Kategory Special Ships now.
22. Panama Event attention  not all ships fit through the canal, but it will be considered when usign the automatic routing,
23. Panam Event always it low on money. Also be careful to choos the right entrance !! Panamax or the new one.
24. NEw Harbours: Odessa, Port Klan Solalah, Tanger Med, Haifa Port, Beirut, Vladiwostok, Murmansk, Noworossijsk, Las Palmas and Nassau
25. Select the Routing, Avoid Suez, Panama, Panamax, NOK (North East Canal), Northeast and Nrthwestpassage (New options, be careful depends on the season if useable withotu icebreaker)
26. Events optimized, more seldom and depending on the level you play. You can always avoid events, atke care on the ship condition and avoid some harbours.
27. SOme bugfixes, as reset of visited harbours when choosing new game, and App updated for fully 64 bit, now preventing a nasty out of memory, also 
as scenes are much larger

notes.title: Major Update 1.50 comming
notes.content:
Now we have design freeze. Hamburg is ready ,also the rest. I spend some time also trimming the gameplay, though I was sucessful with teh old settings it was rather time consuming, some tips, avoid dangerour places, avoid time critical freight. But I reduced the number of events and this is now spreaded over the difficult level, so a beginner will have less events and so be more safe. Also changed the start money so now three ships can be bought at the beginning and you can combine more at startup.
Nearly all of the user wishes have been implemented now. New route planing makes it possible to select if Suez etc is used or not, new the NOK canal and the norwest and the northeast passage (carefully use this option and look at the time of year).

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Work of the next update is full in progress.
1. several bugfixes, e.g. small font, now scsales with the resolution also for proton
2. WASD keys added, also keyboard overrides gamepad if used, but switches back to gamepad automatically.
3. language select on startup when no parameter is given, allows to add new languages easier
4. new languages: Russian, Japanese, Norwegian (in progress)
5. new level in KARA for special ships, as ships like UFO, VIKINGER and NAUTILS (new for cargo now), are more for fun than for the real cargo business.
6. new ship infos as buillding year, amount  of travel (in work)
7. many new backkdrops done by AI
8. info on tug cost on storm events
9.  many other user options which I just do step by step. The most criticial are done already.
